authority: Normalized PURCHASE cost line on ProcurementOrder
calculation: Decimal sum/current authoritative Order cost structure
notes: Original Order purchase currency and manual purchase FX are preserved.

calculation: Purchase + freight + customs/duties + miscellaneous
notes: Excludes input VAT; distinct from Economic Landed Cost HT.

calculation: Landed Cost HT + non-deductible input VAT
notes: Profitability cost; often equals Landed Cost only when input VAT is fully deductible or absent.

authority: Procurement Order pricing mode and current cost structure
calculation: Package sell plus separately recharged freight exactly once
notes: Commercial plan; it is not actual Client revenue.

calculation: Estimated product purchase cost + estimated freight cost
notes: Planning value only.

authority: Project target mode and approved target inputs
calculation: Direct expected sell or markup-derived product/freight sell
notes: Does not replace Order or Invoice values.

calculation: Comparable Invoice HT converted with manual reporting FX
notes: Actual revenue to date for Project target-versus-actual profitability.

calculation: Sum of actual receipts converted using receipt FX
notes: Authoritative actual Client cash in.

calculation: Confirmed Invoice TTC less Client Receipts
notes: Legacy Order CLIENT_RECEIPT schedule remaining is still calculated and exposed elsewhere.

authority: Supplier payable and Supplier Payment schedule/settlements
calculation: Authoritative payable less actual Supplier Payments, with schedule completeness
notes: Expected and actual settlement FX remain independent.

calculation: Client Billing coverage HT − Supplier Order Sell HT
notes: Commercial coverage, not cash.

calculation: Employee-approved planning percentage
notes: Order AUTO allowance uses proportional Order product cost separately.

calculation: Project expected Product Purchase Cost HT × Freight Estimate
notes: Planning only; never based on live actual Order purchase totals.

authority: Order freight cost lines plus ProjectFreightExpense costs
calculation: Comparable actual Order freight + Project-level freight expenses
notes: Separate from expected allowance.

calculation: Each actual freight cost × (1 + applicable freight markup)
notes: Order and Project-expense markup inputs remain identifiable.

authority: Order VAT entry and Project freight-expense VAT
calculation: Recorded supplier-side VAT in original currency
notes: Recoverability classification is separate.

calculation: Input VAT × recoverable rate, converted to Project currency
notes: Excluded from economic cost.

calculation: Order output VAT base × rate
notes: Must not be confused with confirmed Invoice output VAT in VAT Position.

calculation: Comparable confirmed Invoice output VAT
notes: Authoritative VAT-position output side.

calculation: Invoice output VAT − deductible Order/freight-expense input VAT
notes: Positive is VAT Payable; negative is VAT Credit.

calculation: Supplier Order Sell HT − Order Economic Landed Cost HT
notes: Planning/commercial metric.

calculation: Client Invoiced HT − Order/freight-expense Economic Cost HT
notes: Currently shares Gross Profit wording with planned Order result.

calculation: Gross profit ÷ economic landed cost
notes: Aggregate money before deriving a Project rate.

calculation: Gross profit ÷ Sell HT
notes: Never average Order margins.

authority: ClientReceipt actuals; Client Billing installments for forecast
calculation: Actual by received date; expected outstanding by due date
notes: Legacy Order client schedules remain a separate compatibility concern.

authority: PaymentSettlement actuals; Supplier Payment installments for forecast
calculation: Actual by settlement date; expected outstanding by due date
notes: TTC cash basis.

calculation: Cash In − Cash Out for each selected period
notes: Distinct from cumulative Project Cash Position.

authority: Client Billing receipts and Supplier settlements
calculation: Client cash received − Supplier cash paid
notes: Portfolio Project rows use Billing receipts rather than legacy client schedules.
